# Appendix — the completed 2^3 factorial (auto-generated by scripts/analysis_23.py)

Factors: M = schematic notebook memory (arm letter B), A = agenda (C), R = behavioural repulsion (D). Cube cells = the 8 arms A/B/C/D/BC/BD/CD/E over 9 problems x 2 replicates (frac pooled by replicate mean). Effects on the coefficient scale beta_t = (1/8) sum x_t y (half the classical effect). Cell = problem (n = 9); exact paired sign-flip (2^9 = 512); bootstrap 95% CI over problems.
